hub.title: EX Control
hub.description: Each car adds itself the first time it connects: its readings, controls, location and live camera, together on one device per car. On the car, switch on Home Assistant and leave "Use the EX Control integration" on.

camera.title: EX Control live camera
camera.description: For a car whose app does not yet connect to this integration. The car sends its cameras here when you pick one on its Camera control. Use the same stream name as the car's Live camera settings.

old_mobile_app.title: {car} still has its old mobile app device

confirm.title: Remove the old device for {car}?
confirm.description:
{car} now reports through EX Control, so the mobile app device "{old}" no longer updates. Removing it also removes the template controls that one-tap setup put on it, and gives EX Control's entities their names back (sensor.geely_battery instead of sensor.geely_battery_2), so dashboards keep working where names match.

The hidden input helpers it used are left in place; delete them under Settings > Helpers if you like.

init.title: Solar charging
init.description:
Charge this car from spare solar and keep the house battery for the house. Pick the house sensors, then set the car's Solar charging control to Observe for a day (it reports what it would do) and then On.

Mornings, until the departure time, the car charges and does not stop, unless the morning is really cloudy and the car is above its minimum battery. Afternoons it only takes spare solar, after the house battery is on track to be full by sunset. At night it only charges if grid charging is allowed and the car is below its minimum battery.

data.solar_house_battery_power_sign: House battery power is positive when
data.solar_grid_charge: Allow grid charging below the minimum battery
data.solar_tolerance_w: Grid and house battery draw tolerated

data_description.solar_max_w: The most the panels produce on a clear day. Used to look for production the inverter is holding back.
data_description.solar_max_a: Never more than the charger and its circuit are rated for.
data_description.solar_departure: Until this time the car charges without stopping.
data_description.solar_tolerance_w: Draw below this counts as noise, not a deficit.
data_description.solar_forecast_remaining_entity: Open-Meteo Solar Forecast's "Estimated energy production - remaining today". Lets a poor day be seen in the morning, before the clouds show up in the readings.
data_description.solar_forecast_now_entity: Open-Meteo Solar Forecast's "Estimated power production - now". Keeps the search for held-back solar near what the sun can give now.

abort.not_a_car: Solar charging is set per car: open the options of the car's entry.
